verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can attach documents to chat messages and work with them entirely offline via RAG (docs-7). The v0.3.0 blog describes built-in document Q&A that works with any local model (docs-23, docs-24). A community user also mentions RAG plugins such as ChromaDB (comm-4). Missing for 10: no detail on how retrieval is triggered automatically (e.g., chunking/embedding vs. full-context injection), no documentation of supported file types or size limits, and no hands-on report of offline document-chat quality.
